title: Lamb's Club, Black and White Club and Tom Whaley
summary: Waters sorts out which Boston club was which, saying he worked with Tom Whaley at the Lamb's Club, where Hodges could not yet read music, and dates the Hodges period around 1923.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: You said Black and White -
He was still 5 years younger than me, see. But, what did you say?
I said, you said Black and White at one point and then you said Lamb's Club. Was -
No, I'm wrong. Lamb's Club, I worked with Tom Whaley, yeah. That was Tom Whaley, the same Tom Whaley that used to work with Duke Ellington -
Sure -
the same one. That was, that - no, that's somethin' different, I got it mixed up. I went -
The Lamb's -
But that was after the Lamb's, the Black and White -
The Lamb's Club is the place - wait a second - the Lamb's Club is the name of the club that Johnny Hodges worked at starting at 12 midnight -
No, Black and White -
Benny Waters JOHP 6/6/82
Black and White -
That's the one -
The Lamb's Club -
Well, I wasn't working there, see, he was -
You weren't, but that was where he was working -
Yeah -
and the Lamb's Club is where you worked with Tom Whaley later on.

Yeah, yeah. Well, that was a different thing, Phil, that was a commercial deal. We had to play all - that's where I found out that Johnny lied to me, anyway. He couldn't read a note that big at that period.
Johnny Hodges couldn't read -
Nothing. But he had such beautiful tone, he had such big ears that Tom Whaley hired him. And Tom told me "Benny, you show Johnny how to do that".
Was would say this was, 1922 or so -

Well, I would have to be - the first thing I came, I joined Charlie Johnson's band from Boston. I mean, I went from Boston to Philadelphia, you know. I went home, that's my home, Philadelphia, see. That's where I had to join this band at that club, 'cause my home is Bryn Mawr, that's where I'm from, Philadelphia, see what I mean? So I went home, see, and that was in the, around 1925.
So when would you say -
[ ], I went directly from Boston, I stayed with the band till the late 1925, see.
So when do you think you were hangin' out with Johnny Hodges, '24, '23?
Somewhere around that, around that time, '23, something.
